text:
tess: quick thread for tonight's quiet-window mini deploy 00:30 UTC: kernel v2.15.3 + quant qf-2026-06-small. scope: thermal tuning and kv flushing order. rollout: micro-canary 0.2% -> 2% -> 18% -> 100% with 6m holds. auto-pin if 5xx >0.25% or p99 latency delta >9% sustained 5m. cross-region promotion needs yuri OK. preflight 00:00 UTC.

deploybot: job=deploy-5225009999 scheduled; preflight=00:00 UTC. will run prebake+smoke+thermal-check. will post /status updates here.

yuri: noted. primary risk: thermal profile shifts on c-series GPUs; frank, can you watch core temp and power draw? Also, batcher realignment change might shift tail latency.

frank: on it. I'll wire up extra traces for GPU_core_temp, power_watts, batcher_wait_ms. ops-oncall, please have evacuation play ready if nodes therm-trip.

ops-oncall: evacuation playbook ready at /playbooks/thermal-evac.md. sticky-pin TTL available for 3h via deploybot.

ci-bot: preflight run queued (00:00:30). Checks: checksum, prebake image, smoke tests, kv-consistency unit.

tess: RN blurb (draft): "v2.15.3: thermal tuning, kv flush ordering fix, reduced p90 tail on medium sequences". Will publish full RN after 18% step.

deploybot: preflight PASS 00:01 UTC. prebake ok, smoke ok, checksum match. micro-canary 0.2% scheduled 00:30 UTC.

frank: quick local run: p99 delta ~+6% on very long sequences; p90 improved. might be tradeoff at tail. watch p99 closely.

yuri: keep customer-quality metric (accuracy/regression) in the gating too. if token-error-rate (ter) >0.15% absolute, trigger manual pin. who owns ter instrumentation?

nora: I own ter hooks; I'll publish a short diffset that emits ter per-model in the deploy telemetry. will enable at canary start.

deploybot: micro-canary 0.2% started 00:30:05 UTC. metrics: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5225009999. tagging #eng-runtime #eng-sre.

frank: 00:36 UTC initial check: GPU temp +1.2C average, core power +4W. p99 +7% but ter flat. kv-miss unchanged.

tess: we hold until 00:36 then push to 2% at 00:37 if stable. anyone object?

yuri: go for 2% if ter stable and thermal < +3C. I will approve cross-region after 18% hold.

deploybot: promoted to 2% at 00:37:12 UTC. hold 6m.

nora: ter hooks enabled. emitting per-model ter, rolling avg(5m). initial ter: baseline 0.04%, current 0.041% 3 negligible.

ops-oncall: monitoring: no evictions, no OOM. thermal trace stable. standby for 18% promotion.

frank: 00:45 UTC: p99 now +8.9% in one region, ter +0.02% absolute (still within gate). I see one outlier shard with higher batcher_wait_ms. tagging shard id s-77.

tess: hold on 18% until shard s-77 is investigated. frank, can you open an infra trace and capture logs for s-77?

frank: opened trace T-5225010001 and flagged in infra dashboard. short-term mitigation: we can stage a regional pin if s-77 correlates with tenant traffic.

yuri: agree hold. we'll not proceed to 18% without triage. I can join oncall to review traces.

deploybot: promotion paused at 2%. awaiting manual resume. auto-pin still enabled if gates breach.

nora: ter trend looks stable across top models. no model-quality regressions detected so far.

frank: triage note: s-77 outlier appears tied to an older kernel-driver interaction when batcher aligns with specific sequence lengths. workaround: disable the batcher realignment flag on that shard via runtime flag flip: `runtimectl set --shard s-77 --flag batcher_align=false` (hot).

tess: please apply hot-flag on s-77 and rerun local probe. If it stabilizes, we can resume. Frank, ops, coordinate and confirm.

ops-oncall: applied hot-flag to s-77 at 00:52 UTC. rerun probes now.

frank: re-probe 00:54 UTC: p99 delta on s-77 back to +2.1%, overall p99 +5.1%. ter unchanged. ready to resume.

yuri: ok to proceed to 18% after 6m stable check (i.e., resume at ~01:00 UTC). I'll be on the cross-region decision at 01:05 UTC.

deploybot: promoting to 18% at 00:59:58 UTC. hold 6m then final 100% cutover window.

nora: ter hooks steady. emitting 5m avg ter per-model: all within expected drift thresholds.

frank: thermal trend normal, no GPU throttling. batcher_align flag flip seems safe. we should add a follow-up to revert if we observe regressions after 24h.

tess: agreed. will add follow-up task in the deploy ticket. RN will mention the short-lived shard flagging and resolution.

ops-oncall: watch bake window 30m post-100% for any late regressions. sticky-pin TTL set to 3h in case we need time to investigate.

yuri: approving cross-region swap at 01:05:10 UTC. metrics green.

deploybot: final promote to 100% complete 01:12:10 UTC. rollout summary: one shard patch via runtime flag, no auto-pins, no rollbacks. metrics snapshot: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5225009999/summary.

tess: will post RN to #release-notes and add post-deploy follow-up: revert batcher flag on s-77 if no issues after 24h. thanks everyone."
